prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create one finished character selection illustration for a Game Boy game, canvas aspect 10:9. Character: Hakurei Reimu from Touhou, centered adorable upper-body portrait, huge iconic hair bow, long dark hair and sidelocks with white wrapped tips, shrine maiden outfit with white detached sleeves and small neck ribbon. A warmly smiling expressive face, bright large anime eyes, gently tilted head, one closed hand lightly touching her cheek; maximize lovable charming character appeal. Traditional modest costume, head and bow fully inside frame, bust cropped at bottom. Vintage polished Japanese 1990s game pixel illustration, elegant clean readable outlines, chunky intentional pixels, exactly four neutral grayscale tones black/dark gray/light gray/white, large clean shadow shapes, no noisy texture or gradients. Solid pure black background. Portrait silhouette must stay in central 72 percent of canvas width and from 5 to 94 percent of height, leaving both sides blank. Draw one clear white outlined left-pointing chevron arrow at x8 percent/y52 percent and one right-pointing chevron at x92 percent/y52 percent, same style and size, unambiguous image arrows. NO TEXT whatsoever, no numbers, no statistics, no UI panels, no letters, no logos. High-resolution master artwork designed to survive nearest-center reduction to 160x144. Reference image is character identity and monochrome game aesthetic only, replace its full-body composition with the cute close portrait described.

Use case: illustration-story. Create one Game Boy GAME OVER background illustration, aspect 10:9. She is still cute and recognizable, shrine maiden costume with white detached sleeves and neck ribbon, fully clothed, no blood. A chibi-ish bust portrait from chest up occupying x20 to80 percent, y20 to87 percent. Hands hang limply at chest. A tiny drooping spirit-like sigh puff beside her head is welcome. Solid black background, blank top 18 percent and bottom 11 percent reserved for game-rendered text. NO TEXT in artwork. Polished 1990s Japanese monochrome game pixel illustration, exactly four neutral grayscale tones, deliberate chunky pixels, strong silhouette, large light face, simple clean shadows, no gradients or noise. Reference is Reimu identity and period monochrome style; change pose and expression to the funny defeated scene described. This will be reduced to 160x144, so prioritize readable facial emotion.
